title: Design System: D&D Combat Roll Simulator

components.name: Roll Button
components.description: The one primary action; accent fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-roll { background: var(--accent); color: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; font: 700 1rem/1.5 var(--font-prose); min-height: 32px; padding: 0 var(--sp-4); } .ds-btn-roll:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 85%, var(--ink)); } .ds-btn-roll:active { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 70%, var(--ink)); } .ds-btn-roll:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Preset Button
components.description: Secondary to Roll: sets the controls to a worked example.
components.css: .ds-btn-preset { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink-muted); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; font: 700 1rem/1.5 var(--font-prose); min-height: 32px; padding: var(--sp-1) var(--sp-3); text-align: left; } .ds-btn-preset:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--paper) 85%, var(--ink)); } .ds-btn-preset:active { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--paper) 75%, var(--ink)); } .ds-btn-preset:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Step Button
components.description: Small exact adjustments, and Reset at natural width.
components.css: .ds-btn-step { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink-muted); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 var(--font-num); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; height: 32px; padding: 0 var(--sp-2); } .ds-btn-step:hover:not([aria-disabled="true"]) { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--paper) 85%, var(--ink)); } .ds-btn-step:active:not([aria-disabled="true"]) { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--paper) 75%, var(--ink)); } .ds-btn-step[aria-disabled="true"] { background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink-muted); border-color: var(--line); cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-step:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Slider And Number
components.description: A labeled range paired with an exact number box, inside the control strip.
components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-4); align-items: flex-end; padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-4); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--font-prose); color: var(--ink); } .ds-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--sp-1); } .ds-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-hint { font-weight: 400; font-size: 0.75rem; margin-left: var(--sp-1); color: var(--ink-muted); } .ds-pair { display: flex; gap: var(--sp-2); align-items: center; } .ds-range { width: 7rem; height: 32px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent); } .ds-num { width: 80px; height: 32px; font-family: var(--font-num); font-size: 1rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: center; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); caret-color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--ink-muted); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-range:focus-visible, .ds-num:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Die Selector
components.description: Joined segments over real radios; the checked die takes the accent fill.
components.css: .ds-segs { display: flex; } .ds-segs label { position: relative; display: block; } .ds-segs input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); } .ds-segs span { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 48px; height: 32px; margin-left: -1px; font: 400 0.875rem/1 var(--font-num); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink-muted); cursor: pointer; } .ds-segs label:first-child span { margin-left: 0; border-radius: 4px 0 0 4px; } .ds-segs label:last-child span { border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; } .ds-segs input:not(:checked) + span:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface) 85%, var(--ink)); } .ds-segs input:checked + span { background: var(--accent); color: var(--paper); font-weight: 700; } .ds-segs input:focus-visible + span { position: relative; z-index: 1; outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-figs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 13rem); gap: var(--sp-3); font-family: var(--font-prose); color: var(--ink); } .ds-fig { display: grid; gap: var(--sp-2); padding: var(--sp-3); border-radius: 8px; align-content: start; } .ds-fig-exact { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-top: 3px solid var(--ink); } .ds-fig-sim { background: var(--paper); border: 1px dashed var(--ink-muted); } .ds-fig-label { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--ink-muted); } .ds-fig-value { font: 700 1.75rem/1.2 var(--font-num); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-fig-sd { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink-muted); }

components.css: .ds-outcome { border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; font: 400 0.875rem var(--font-num); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink); } .ds-outcome th, .ds-outcome td { width: 40px; height: 24px; line-height: 24px; padding: 0; text-align: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-outcome th { background: var(--surface); font-weight: 700; } .ds-outcome td.ds-note { width: 128px; padding-left: var(--sp-1); text-align: left; font-family: var(--font-prose); font-style: italic; background: var(--paper); } .ds-h { --s: calc(var(--t) * 2 * var(--ramp-a)); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--heat-hi) calc(var(--s) * 100%), var(--heat-lo)); color: var(--cell-ink-lo); } .ds-h.ds-hi { --s: calc(var(--ramp-b) + (var(--t) - 0.5) * 2 * (1 - var(--ramp-b))); color: var(--cell-ink-hi); } .ds-m { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--miss-bg) 0 4px, color-mix(in oklch, var(--miss-bg) 85%, var(--ink)) 4px 5px); color: var(--miss-ink); } .ds-threshold > * { box-shadow: inset 0 3px 0 0 var(--rule); } .ds-crit > * { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 var(--accent); } .ds-crit-word { color: var(--accent); } .ds-roll { position: relative; } .ds-roll::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; border: 2px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--paper); }

components.name: Verdict Line
components.description: The answer in one line of body type on paper; bold lead, never a card.
components.html: +1 to damage wins here. It adds 0.550 per round; +1 to hit adds 0.225.
components.css: .ds-verdict { margin: 0; padding: var(--sp-2) 0; background: var(--paper); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font: 400 1rem/1.5 var(--font-prose); color: var(--ink); } .ds-verdict b { font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
The page is a rules page a designer has worked through: parchment, ink and margin notes, with exact tables and the explanations beside them. Words are set like a book and figures like a ledger. The tables are the subject, so everything around them stays quiet, and the strongest color on the page is damage itself.

The system is dense, flat and ruled. Depth comes from two tonal surfaces, hairlines and ink rules; controls are plain, compact and exact. There are two designed themes, parchment and candlelit, each hand-set in oklch rather than inverted. The operating system's color preference picks between them.

Nothing moves. Results appear at once, with no transitions and no animation, by decision. There are no motion tokens because there is no motion.
keyCharacteristics: Parchment and candlelit, both hand-set in oklch.
Georgia for words, system-ui with tabular numerals for standing figures.
Flat and ruled: no cast shadows, no transparency, no motion.
One heat ramp across every table; misses are hatched.
Accent fill only on Roll and the checked die.

rules.name: The One Heat Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every outcome table and the legend share one scale: a cell's position is its damage over the largest cell across all the tables on the page, so the same damage is the same color everywhere. Never give a table its own domain. The mix toward Deep Ember runs from 0 to `--ramp-a` below the midpoint and from `--ramp-b` to 100% at or above it (0.62 and 0.70 in parchment, 0.56 and 0.72 in candlelit), and the cell ink flips at that same point.

rules.name: The Hatched Miss Rule
rules.body: A miss is a 135° hatch (4px ground, 1px of ground with 15% ink) with a printed 0, never a color alone. It is a required cue, and a deliberate exception to the detector's repeating-stripes advisory. The hatch means miss and nothing else.

rules.name: The Reserved Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent as a fill belongs to Roll and the checked die. The only other accent ground is the browser's text selection. Crits use accent as a line and as bold words, and the crit swatch in the legend uses the heat ramp, not the accent.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Georgia sets words; system-ui with tabular numerals sets every figure that stands as data: table cells, stat values, control values, formula lines, chart ticks, the readout, the round log. A number inside a sentence or a small supporting line stays in Georgia, unless it is set as a figure in its own right. Headings are never system-ui.

rules.name: The Installed Faces Rule
rules.body: The page makes no external requests, and its content security policy would block a font file if it tried. No webfonts: both stacks resolve to what the reader's machine has.

rules.name: The Four Sizes Rule
rules.body: Four sizes (12, 14, 16 and 28px) and two weights (400 and 700). Hierarchy comes from face, weight, caps and ink before it comes from size. Chart text steps its user units by container width so it renders at 12px or more.

rules.name: The Flat And Ruled Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow, at rest or in any state, including the sticky bar. If a surface needs separating, it gets a tone or a hairline. Inset, zero-blur rules inside tables are the only `box-shadow` allowed.

rules.name: The One Focal Figure Rule
rules.body: A 3px ink top rule marks one figure: the exact expected damage over 20 rounds, on its stat card and on its figure card beside the simulated run. No other card gets it. It is an ink rule rather than an accent hue, and a deliberate exception to the detector's border-accent rule.

rules.name: The Exact Versus Simulated Rule
rules.body: Exact and simulated figures never share styling. Exact is a solid vellum card under the focal ink rule, with one decimal and a spread; simulated is a dashed outline on parchment with a whole number. Their labels say which is which, so no cue is color.

rules.name: The Stale Ink Rule
rules.body: When settings move on from a rolled run, values go to faded ink, frames go to hairline, and a sentence says so; the sentence itself stays in full ink. Never opacity, and no element on the page uses it.

dos: Do derive heat from the shared page-wide maximum, per The One Heat Ramp Rule.
Do draw any new table rule as an inset, zero-blur line or a 1px hairline, so it never shifts layout.
Do tune candlelit values by hand when adding a color; set both themes in oklch.
Do tell states apart with words, stroke or hatch as well as color.
Do keep text tokens at 4.5:1 or better on their grounds in both themes.
Do stay on the 4 to 24px spacing scale, the four type sizes and the two weights.
donts: Don't cast a shadow from any surface, including the sticky bar.
Don't add transitions, animation or smooth scrolling; results appear at once.
Don't use opacity to dim stale, disabled or secondary content.
Don't fill anything with accent except Roll and the checked die.
Don't give a table its own heat scale, or use the hatch for anything but a miss.
Don't put the 3px ink top rule on any figure but exact expected damage over 20 rounds.
Don't let exact and simulated figures share a card style.
Don't load a webfont or any other external resource, or set headings in system-ui.
